_about: True 1.65 Mode quest reward fixes (plan section 4, 'Invented quest rewards'), made 2026-10-30 from pre-1 Nov 2003 Wayback captures of the Allakhazam item pages. 'updates' are targeted, idempotent SQL statements (ItemTemplate by Id_nb; DataQuest reward lists by ID, editing only FinalRewardItemTemplates). 'remove' is empty on purpose: the statless step items are taken out of reward lists by the DataQuest updates, no row is archived or deleted.
